column117: VANCOUVER Nevsun Resources  a Canadian miner which has been approached regarding a takeover  should enter "good-faith negotiations with any suitor " Adrian Day Asset Management  one of Nevsun's top 10 shareholders  said in an open letter to the company's board on Wednesday.
